candidates.snippet: Post-Punk, Cold Wave and Industrial Gigs in Berlin Berlin is a fixed stop on the European touring circuit for this music, and a scene of its own between tours. This page lists upcoming Berlin gigs that fall within what Catastrophe Ballet covers: post-punk, cold and dark wave, industrial, EBM, minimal and synth wave. Dates are grouped by month. We write from Brussels. This is a curated agenda, not a local guide — selected by the same editorial line as the rest of the site, and no more exhaustive than our time allows. Where we have written about an artist, the listing links to the piece. .cb-hub
